about: Recorded replies for the offline demo of scripts/relaxed/intake.ts, keyed <chain>|<text>. The four below were WRITTEN BY HAND on 2026-10-08 as the expected shape of the model's answer, not returned by a model: provenance mock. Run with --record once ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is set to replace them with live replies.

robinhood|I want to invest in Elon.understood: You want to invest in the companies Elon Musk leads: Tesla and SpaceX, both on this table.

lines.why: Tesla, the company Elon Musk runs; electric vehicles and energy
SpaceX, which he founded and runs; rockets and Starlink

not_available.name: xAI
not_available.why: private company, not on this table

robinhood|the chip makers.understood: You want the semiconductor companies on this table.

lines.why: TSMC, the largest contract chip maker
ASML, the lithography machines chips are made with

robinhood|I have 10k, grow it for my kid.understood: You have 10,000 to grow over the long term for your children, with no date or risk stated.

robinhood|metade em algo seguro, metade.understood: Você quer metade do dinheiro em algo seguro e a outra metade em Tesla.

lines.why: fundo de títulos curtos do Tesouro americano, o mais conservador da tabela

robinhood|i want to invest in big techs.understood: You want to invest in big technology companies.

robinhood|safe liquid yields.understood: You want a conservative investment with safe, liquid yields.

lines.why: U.S. Treasury bills, safe and liquid
a stock, to show the rule
